I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm I've noted the new Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff of 7 July. Today is 14 Oct 2026, so I said I'm reading that as 7 July 2027 and asked them to tell me if that's wrong.

They asked me to keep it between us, so the note lives only in that DM. I didn't save it to GBrain, memory or any channel, because other members could see it there. I checked GBrain first and it had nothing about this cutoff. Its search was running in keyword-only mode, so a miss there doesn't prove there's nothing.
